card.title: IPad Pro 12.9 No backlight after screen replacement repair

source.title: IPad Pro 12.9 No backlight after screen replacement repair

claims.statement: iPad Pro 12.9 (1st/2nd gen) losing backlight after a screen job usually has one or both backlight filters blown by plugging the screen with the battery connected.
Replacement filter: 0402 120 Ω 1.5 A ferrite (e.g. MPZ1005S121ETD25); jumpering it is not recommended.
Backlight diodes are shared with iPad Air 1–3, Pro 9.7/10.5/11 1st/12.9 1st–2nd and iPad 5/6; the backlight controller (8566 5AR5) is shared with iPad 7 and iPad 9.

procedure: Check both backlight filters for continuity.
Replace filters, caps or diodes; then the backlight controller 8566.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Jumpering a filter instead of replacing it leaves the circuit unprotected.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
